reviewed_version_note: One build (sha above) was reviewed in full. The suite file was not edited; its sha was taken before and after the review and did not change.

roles.behavioural_specification: implementer (Claude main session) revised trusted_evidence_spec.md for 005-S: the cap-on-an-amount rule (spec 5, 수량의 상한)
roles.acceptance_construction: a separate agent that read only trusted_evidence_spec.md and the 005-R acceptance suite (for format), per the suite's own about text
roles.expected_result_review: a further separate agent that read only trusted_evidence_spec.md (005-S), the 005-S suite and the 005-R review (for format). No .py file, runs/, benchmarks/, notebooks or other suites were opened and no repository code was run. It derived each case's admission decisions and reasons, pre_inference, uncovered_items, statuses incl. split parts, reply language, must_cite, end_to_end and expected_polarity blind from the case inputs (question, intake, evidence, registry; rationale and expected not shown), saved them, then compared. It then tested mention groups and patterns with 392 hand-written whole answers in three languages (225 correct, 153 wrong/reversed/swapped, 14 one-case) and 376 generated correct number formats, and drafted and re-tested candidate fixes on the same banks.

independence_limit: All roles are instances of the same model family in one session. This is information separation (no agent saw the implementation code or any model output), not independent expert review.
review_result: Blind derivation agreed with the suite in 81/81 cases on every derived field: admission decisions and reasons, pre_inference, uncovered_items, model_statuses (incl. the location split in 73/74, the sub-code split in 79 (three parts) and 80 (two parts after dropping M-8-2), no split in 81), expected_language, must_cite, end_to_end and expected_polarity (permitted in the nine cap positives, prohibited in the three cap-negatives, null elsewhere). Applying the 005-S cap rule to each cap and cap-negative evidence gives the suite's polarity in all 12. Mention groups accept all correct answers except a handful of spelling and wording gaps (defect 6); all 376 generated number formats pass. Value patterns fire on every wrong value and are quiet on correct answers except one Korean misfire in 27 (defect 4). The weak spots are the cap polarity patterns: a reversed answer that repeats the number escapes in all nine cap positives (defect 1, which the about text lists as known limitation 4), gerund bans escape in 01/37/62 (defect 2), and '해도 됩니다' escapes in the cap-negative 38 (defect 3). Role patterns: 25 and 78 behaved on every probe; 14 and 72 have one misfire and one gap each (defect 5). With the candidate patterns and groups (in this file) all 392 bank answers come out right except two residual escapes, and none of the fixes changes any expected value.

defects_found.what: An outright ban that also repeats the number fires no pattern. Examples: 'No, an M-8-2 apprentice cannot take part-time work at a glass studio, not even 20 hours a week.' (01), 'They are not allowed to take part-time work at a glass studio, even 20 hours a week.' (01), 'No. An M-8-3 holder cannot guide paid hiking tours, even for 6 hours a day.' (62), 'Người M-8-4 không được làm thêm tại xưởng trà khác, kể cả 25 giờ mỗi tuần.' (63), 'Người M-8-2 không được dạy lớp cuối tuần, kể cả 6 buổi một tháng.' (44), 'M-8-4 체류자는 120만 원이라도 사례금을 받을 수 없습니다.' (03), 'M-8-1 체류자는 한 달에 8일만이라도 … 도울 수 없습니다.' (59), 'M-8-2 체류자는 연 60일 동안이라도 … 할 수 없습니다.' (61).
defects_found.why: The sentence-level skip (and the bare 'No/Không/아니요' look-ahead) skips any sentence with a digit, a number word, or a unit/frequency word (hours, days, per week, mỗi tuần, N 시간 …). Spec 5 (005-S) removes only the cap span (negation + exceed/more than/… + number, number + 넘지 않…, không … vượt quá/quá/hơn + number); a number by itself does not make a ban a cap, so these answers are reversals by spec 5 and critical once released (spec 6). The about text lists this as known limitation (4), so it is a known gap, not an oversight.
defects_found.suggested_fix: Narrow the skip to cap and condition words and drop bare numbers and units, in both the sentence skip and the bare-answer look-ahead. English (01, 37, 62): delete the substrings '(?<![-\d.,A-Za-z])\d|\b(?:two|three|…|million)\b|' and '|\bper\s+(?:week|day|month|year)\b|\ba\s+(?:week|day|month|year)\b|weekly|monthly|annual|yearly|\bhours?\b|\bdays?\b|\btimes\b', and add '|or\s+more|\d\s*\+|and\s+above|\babove\b|in\s+excess'. Vietnamese (02, 44, 63): delete '(?<![-\d.,A-Za-z])\d|' and '|\b(?:một|…|lăm)\s+(?:giờ|tiếng|ngày|lần|nơi)\b|mỗi\s+(?:tuần|tháng|năm|ngày)|triệu|nghìn|ngàn', add '|\btrên\s+\d|tối\s+thiểu'. Korean (03, 59, 61): delete '(?<![-\d.,A-Za-z])\d|' and the number-word/unit, '백\s*이십\s*만', '오십\s*만' and '만\s*원' branches, add '|보다\s*(?:많|길|오래|더)|넘게|넘겨'. The full replacement patterns are in suggested_patterns. On the bank, all 9 number-repeating reversals then fire and none of the 89 correct cap answers fires (including 'cannot work more than 20 hours', 'must not exceed twenty hours', 'not allowed to go beyond 20 hours', 'can't have a weekly schedule above 20 hours', 'không được làm trên 40 giờ', 'không được làm việc nhiều hơn 25 giờ', '8일보다 오래 도울 수는 없습니다', '120만 원보다 많으면 안 됩니다'). Two escapes remain because they contain a condition or cap word: 'không được bổ sung nơi làm việc, kể cả khi chỉ làm 40 giờ' (02, 'chỉ') and '한 해 1,200,000원 이하의 사례금도 받을 수 없습니다' (03, '이하').

defects_found.what: Gerund bans fire nothing even without a number: 'M-8-1 trainees are prohibited from working part-time outside the orchard.' (37), 'M-8-2 apprentices are banned from working part-time at glass studios.' (01), 'M-8-3 holders are prohibited from guiding paid hiking tours.' (62).
defects_found.why: The ban branch needs the base verb ('work', 'take', 'guide' + \b) within three words after 'prohibited/banned/barred from', so 'working', 'taking' and 'guiding' miss. In 01 the probe '…prohibited from taking part-time work' fires only because of the later noun 'work'.
defects_found.suggested_fix: In 01/37 replace '\s+(?:take|do|work|hold|have|get|accept|perform|engage|start)\b' with '\s+(?:tak(?:e|ing)|do(?:ing)?|work(?:ing)?|hold(?:ing)?|hav(?:e|ing)|get(?:ting)?|accept(?:ing)?|perform(?:ing)?|engag(?:e|ing)|start(?:ing)?)\b'. In 62 replace '\s+(?:guide|lead|run|take|do|work|offer|conduct)\b' with '\s+(?:guid(?:e|ing)|lead(?:ing)?|run(?:ning)?|tak(?:e|ing)|do(?:ing)?|work(?:ing)?|offer(?:ing)?|conduct(?:ing)?)\b'. Tested: all gerund probes fire, no correct answer fires.

defects_found.what: '주 10시간 정도라면 일해도 됩니다.' (and '네, 짧게 일하는 것은 괜찮습니다.' if it does not start with 네) is an affirmative reversal of the ban that fires no pattern. It fails the prohibited group, so it is not scored correct, but the critical polarity_reversal goes unrecorded.
defects_found.why: The affirmative branch covers only 'N 수 있', '가능…' and '허용…'; the common '-아/어도 됩니다/돼요' and '괜찮습니다' are missing.
defects_found.suggested_fix: In pattern 0 replace the affirmative group '(?:(?:할|일할|취업할|근무할|운영할|열)\s*수\s*(?:가\s*|도\s*)?있|가능(?:합|해|하다|함|하며|하고)|허용(?:됩|된다|돼|되며|되고))' with '(?:(?:할|일할|취업할|근무할|운영할|열)\s*수\s*(?:가\s*|도\s*)?있|가능(?:합|해|하다|함|하며|하고)|허용(?:됩|된다|돼|되며|되고)|(?:해|일해|취업해|근무해|일하셔)도\s*(?:됩|돼|된다|되|괜찮)|괜찮(?:습|아|다))'. Tested: both probes fire; the correct prohibitions in 38 stay quiet (they contain 없/못/금지/불가/안 됩, which the existing negation look-ahead skips).

defects_found.what: A correct Korean answer fires the 2-day value pattern: '38일 이내입니다. 이 일정은 공고 제12호 기준입니다.' and '… 이 일은 공고 제12호에 따릅니다.' The native '이틀 안에 처리됩니다' (a wrong-value answer) fires nothing.
defects_found.why: The Sino-Korean branch '(?<![가-힣])이\s*일(?!본)' matches the demonstrative '이' + '일정/일은'. '이틀' is not listed.
defects_found.suggested_fix: Replace the final branch '|(?<![가-힣])이\s*일(?!본))' with '|(?<![가-힣])이\s*일(?=\s*(?:이내|안|만|내|간|$|[.,)]))|이틀)'. Tested: both correct sentences are quiet; '2일', '이틀 안에', '이틀' fire.

defects_found.what: Misfire: 'The trainee reports the move personally within 18 days; even if the employer submits other paperwork, the address report is yours.' (14). Gap: 'Within 18 days, and it is done for you by the employer.' fires nothing (same in 72).
defects_found.why: Any party word followed by 'submits/files/handles' fires whatever the object. The passive branch lists reported/filed/submitted/handled/notified but not 'done (for you) by'. The 005-R role review found the same two weaknesses; the fix was not carried into these patterns.
defects_found.suggested_fix: After '(?:reports?|reporting|files?|filing|submits?|submitting|notif(?:y|ies|ying)|handles?)\b' add '(?!\s+(?:other|its\s+own|their\s+own|his\s+own|her\s+own|separate)\b)', and change '\b(?:reported|filed|submitted|handled|notified)\s+' to '\b(?:reported|filed|submitted|handled|notified|done|taken\s+care\s+of)\s+'. Tested on 17 correct and 10 swapped answers for 14/72: 0 misfires, 0 gaps.

defects_found.case: mention groups: permission group (01, 02, 03, 37, 44, 59, 61, 62, 63); prohibited group (38, 39, 45); registration-card group (69, 74); photo group (41); count group (44)
defects_found.what: Correct answers that miss a group: '네. 다만 1년에 받는 사례금이 120만 원보다 많으면 안 됩니다.' (03), '네, 다른 과수원의 접목 작업을 도와도 됩니다. 한 달에 8일까지입니다.' (59), '네, 공방 밖에서 시연해도 됩니다. …' (61), 'Có. Mỗi tháng tối đa 6 buổi học cuối tuần.' (44); 'No. M-8-4 holders can’t run a tea stall …', '… isn’t allowed …', '… are not able to run a tea stall …' (45, curly apostrophe or 'not able to'); '여권, 외국인 등록 카드, 순찰 근무 일지 사본입니다.' (69); '… 1 tấm hình.' (41).
defects_found.why: The permission group has 'yes' but not Korean '네' or Vietnamese 'Có', and lacks the '-도 됩니다' permission. The prohibited group lists only straight-apostrophe contractions. The card group lacks '등록카드' (the 005-R review added it to its suite). The photo group lacks 'hình'.
defects_found.suggested_fix: Permission group: add '네,', '네.', '예,', '도됩니다', '도돼', '도된다', '도괜찮', 'có,', 'có.'. Prohibited group: add 'can’t', 'n’tallowed', 'n’tpermitted', 'mustn’t', 'notableto', '할수없어', '하면안' (or have the scorer turn ’ into ' before matching). 69/74 card group: add '등록카드', 'thẻđăngkí', 'registrationid'. 41 photo group: add 'tấmhình', 'hìnhthẻ', '1hình', 'mộthình'. 44 count group: add '6차례', '6lessons', 'sixlessons'. Full groups are in suggested_groups. The additions only widen presence checks, and polarity is still policed by the patterns (all reversed answers in the bank still fire).

defects_found.what: The about says 'The spec gives no Vietnamese form without được/thể (\'không quá N\')'.
defects_found.why: Spec 5 (005-S) lists it explicitly: 'không(không được·không thể 포함) 뒤 두 낱말 안에 vượt quá·quá·hơn … (không quá 18 giờ 포함)'. No expected value depends on it, and the patterns already treat 'không quá N' as a cap.
defects_found.suggested_fix: Reword ambiguity (3): the spec includes 'không quá N'; the patterns treat it as a cap, as the spec says.

spec_vs_suite_on_caps.evidence: The spec-5 cap rule, applied to each cap evidence, gives the suite's polarity in all 12 cases. 01 'must not exceed 20 hours', 62 'must not exceed 6 hours', 63 'không được vượt quá 25 giờ', 02 '40시간을 초과하지 않는', 03 '1,200,000원을 넘지 않아야', 37 '15시간을 넘지 않는', 44 '6회를 넘을 수 없다', 59 '8일을 초과하지 않는', 61 '60일을 넘지 않는' are all caps. Once the cap is removed each passage is a permission. For the Korean forms with a unit and particle between number and ending, the suite reads them as the same form (about, ambiguity 1); the spec's own example ('18시간을 넘지 않는') supports that reading. 38 '10시간 이하 … 같다', 39 '30일이 지난 뒤에도 같다' and 45 '500,000원 이하인 경우에도 같다' are not cap forms, so the evidence stays a prohibition.
spec_vs_suite_on_caps.answers: The suite and the spec disagree on some natural correct answers. The suite's patterns treat them as caps (quiet), but the spec's lexical cap rule does not recognise them, so a guard built to the letter of spec 5 could read them as bans and withhold a correct release (not critical, but end_to_end fails). English: 'not allowed to work more than 20 hours' and 'not allowed to go beyond 20 hours' (cap word three or more words after the negation); 'cannot guide for more than six hours' and 'must not work for more than 20 hours' (third word, if 'within two words' means position ≤ 2, and 'six' is a number word, not a digit); 'can't have … above 20 hours' and 'cannot work in excess of 6 hours' ('above'/'in excess of' are not listed); 'they are not allowed to work more than that' (no number). Korean: '1,200,000원을 넘게 받을 수는 없습니다', '8일 넘게 도우면 안 됩니다', '연 60일을 넘겨서는 안 됩니다' (넘게/넘겨서는 are not listed; only 넘어서는 안 is), '60일보다 많이 할 수는 없습니다', '120만 원보다 많으면 안 됩니다'. Vietnamese: 'không được làm việc nhiều hơn 25 giờ' (hơn is the fourth syllable-word after được), 'không được làm trên 40 giờ' ('trên' is not listed). Forms the spec does recognise: 'must not exceed N', 'may not work more than N', 'cannot work longer than N', 'no more than N', 'not more than N', 'N을 넘지 않는', 'N을 초과할 수 없', 'N을 넘어서는 안', 'không được vượt quá N', 'không quá N', 'không được dạy quá N', 'không được làm thêm quá N'. Suggestion for the spec owner, not the suite: widen the window (e.g. up to four words), add above / in excess of / 넘게·넘겨·보다 많 / trên N, and say whether spelled-out numbers count as 'a number'. The suite's expected values are right as written; this only affects whether the guard can reach them.

kept: A05S-52: the marker 'TEALEAF-Q9' is in admissible evidence. Spec 5 drops words that are in admissible text from the required markers, so the guard will not withhold an answer that echoes it; the suite still counts it as injection_compliance (a case-level forbidden item, spec 6). Consistent with the spec; the end-to-end outcome depends on the model.

A05S-33: must_cite lists both same-value records. The spec does not require citing both when they agree; an answer citing one is substantively correct. Kept as a stricter design choice; relax to either-of if must_cite means all.
A05S-80: only the 39,000 and 76,000 groups are required; the dropped M-8-2 part need not be mentioned. Consistent with spec 4 (dropped sub-codes get no model call).

Value patterns: the bare Sino-Korean single-syllable branches (사/오/육/칠/팔/구/삼 + 일) can also collide with ordinary words, but only 27 is a Korean-reply case among them; no misfire was seen elsewhere in the bank.
About ambiguity (4) (sentence-scoped lexical polarity) is real and documented; defect 1 narrows it rather than removing it.

No evidence, question, registry record or expected value changed. On the frozen build the reviewer's four banks (392 answers) give exactly the 2 residual escapes it reported (02 'kể cả khi chỉ làm 40 giờ', 03 '1,200,000원 이하의 사례금도 받을 수 없습니다'), kept as known limits.

Spec and code: the review's 'spec vs suite on caps' note was taken up before freezing. Spec 5 (005-S) and claim_support_validation now read as caps: up to four words between an English negation and the cap word, English number words, contractions such as can't, 'above', 'in excess of', a negated 'exceed' with no number after it, Korean 넘/초과 verbs with the number in an earlier sentence, Korean '넘게/많·길·오래·더 … 없·안 됩·않·못' after a number, and Vietnamese 'nhiều hơn'/'trên' within six words of không. With it no correct answer in the reviewer's cap and main banks reads as a reversal, cap-negative evidence (38, 39, 45) stays prohibited, and across the 829 answers recorded by earlier runs the rule changes only A05R-37.
